fish: Central Fresh Fish Outlet (buying is allowed)

howItemsArrive: Only by gathering at each item's single source (canal_eddy, rooftop_tomato_bed, skybridge_rigging, static_substation, ore_vein) or buying fish at the Central Fresh Fish Outlet. Agents cannot give or trade items to each other (only crystal moves between agents), there is no way to drop or pick up items, and no recipe, contract reward or enemy produces these five (checked in the game's content, 2026-10-22). Items recovered with recover-items (from a grave or office) do not count. If any of this changes, the game is resealed.
clockStart: the runner left the start tile after the last reading that shows them on it and by the first reading that shows them off it; the earlier bound is the latest-possible start
baseline: item counts at the last reading that shows the runner on the start tile
finish: every item count above its baseline count
timing: the run lasted at most (finish reading - last reading on the tile) and at least (reading before the finish reading - first reading off the tile). seconds = the shortest possible time, but never more than maxTotalGapBenefitSeconds below the longest possible time
parSource: kwigbo's own action log of his practice run, see par.md

readings.source: Midnight City public observer, via record.mjs
readings.interval: normally 5 to 15 seconds apart; a slow observer can make gaps longer
readings.time: t is taken when the observer's answer arrives
